subject: Post-call recap: Redwood Inference intro & next steps (AuroraMed)
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: priya@auroramed.com, marcus.lee@auroramed.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T15:00:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood Inference intro & next steps (AuroraMed)

Hi Priya / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discussion and clear next steps so everyone has the same view. I’ve included Marissa and Aditya from our team for procurement and implementation follow-up.

Summary of what we heard (pain & context):
- Primary pain: inconsistent inference latency and high per-token cost on current orchestration, causing poor UX on clinician-facing summaries.
- Business impact: delayed turnaround for clinical notes (~6–12s per request), higher operational cost; conservative caching prevents reuse of common prompts.
- Security/regulatory: AuroraMed needs PHI-safe handling, SOC 2 attestation, and option for VPC/private deployment for sensitive workloads.

Goals you shared:
- Reduce median latency to <2s for 95% of requests for the clinician UI.
- Cut per-inference unit cost by ~40% while preserving summary quality.
- Roll out a pilot with 2–3 clinical teams by end of Q4 for evaluation (prod-ish traffic).

Risk/constraints we noted:
- Procurement timeline: Marcus indicated a 6–8 week procurement window; contract language and data residency controls are gating items.
- Technical: need for PHI-safe routing and KMS integration for keys; telemetry & audit logs required for vendor validation.

Proposed next steps (owner & ETA):
1) Redwood to share SOW + SOC2 summary and a short pilot plan (Laura) — by EOD Monday (2026-08-31).
2) Technical scoping session (deep dive on VPC & KMS) — schedule for next week; target attendees: Anil (CTO), Marissa (solutions), Aditya (sales eng).
3) Procurement: Redwood to provide contract summary + sample T&Cs for legal review (Aditya) — within two business days after SOW.
4) Exec alignment: Priya to confirm pilot stakeholders and procurement path (AuroraMed) — update by 2026-09-03.

Attachments we’ll send: SOW draft (high level), SOC2 summary (controls matrix).

If that matches your expectations, we’ll proceed with the SOW and lock a time for the technical scoping.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (summary), SOC2_summary.xlsx (controls)

From: Priya Shah <priya@auroramed.com>

Date: 2026-08-30T20:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood Inference intro & next steps (AuroraMed)

Laura — thanks for the recap and clear list. That aligns with what we discussed. Two quick asks from my side: 

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for keying PHI and whether logs can be sent to our Splunk instance for audit? Marcus will want the details for procurement.
2) We need to understand data residency options (US-only) and any differences in the pilot vs. production environment.

We’re generally interested in the pilot timeline you proposed. I’ve looped Marcus for procurement and will follow up after he shares the procurement intake details. Please include Anil (CTO) on the technical invite — he’ll want to attend the scoping session.

Thanks —
Priya
VP Clinical Ops | AuroraMed
priya@auroramed.com

Priya / Marcus —

Appreciate the quick reply. Confirming next steps and sending initial artifacts: attached SOW_draft_v1.pdf and SOC2_summary.xlsx. High-level answers to Priya’s asks: 
- Customer-managed KMS: supported for Private deployments (we can integrate with your KMS/HSM). For Hosted API we offer envelope encryption options; we’ll detail trade-offs in the SOW.
- Audit logs: we can forward structured logs to your Splunk instance (TLS + syslog/HTTPS ingestion). We’ll include required field mappings in the technical pre-reads.
- Data residency: US-only deployment is supported; the pilot can run in our US-region Dedicated pool, production options include VPC/private deployment for stricter controls.

Proposed 60-minute technical scoping slots (please pick one):
- Tue 2026-09-01 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 2026-09-02 09:00–10:00 PT

I’ll schedule once you confirm Anil’s availability. Aditya — I’ll send the SOW + contract summary to procurement list once we have a confirmed scoping time.

DocuSign link for the initial NDA/engagement (if you want to accelerate) is here: https://www.docusign.com/en/document/abc123

Talk soon —
